entry.long: completed close crosses above chart-visible Leading Span A; enter next candle open
entry.short: completed close crosses below chart-visible Leading Span B; enter next candle open

protective_stop.atr_information_time: last fully completed 1h candle before entry
protective_stop.gap_rule: fill at candle open when open gaps beyond stop

capital_model.position_sizing: fixed 10x exposure on current equity, reinvest operation by operation
capital_model.note: Backtest leverage model; exact exchange liquidation, maintenance margin and funding mechanics are not represented unless separately implemented.

change_control: Do not change entry, target, stop, costs, causality, leverage or position sizing silently. Any future modification must be tested as a separately named candidate against this frozen protocol.
